proposals.evidence: Full phala explicitly gives Oriya phaḷa, Gujarati/Marathi phaḷ, West Pahari phaḷ/phal and Kotgarhi phɔḷ fruit; Kumaoni phaw supplies a reduced-lateral comparison. These support selected fruit responses with preserved lateral/fricative notation and local glide/reduction variants. Source vowels and final inflection remain intact; exact local phonetic history and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. No phulla flower link or doubtful apple comparison is substituted. Exact response: ɸaye.
